knowledge.summary_en: Kinyarwanda features various dialects and regional variations across different regions of Rwanda. Living in different provinces leads to slight differences in vocabulary and pronunciation. However, all Kinyarwanda speakers easily understand each other throughout the country.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gukirana kwari umuco ukomeye mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Byari bifite umumaro wo kwigisha ubutwari no guteza imbere imbaraga z'umubiri. Abasore bahiganwaga mu birori bitandukanye kugira ngo bagaragaze ubuhanga n'ubushobozi bwabo bwo gutsinda.
knowledge.summary_en: Traditional wrestling was an important cultural practice in ancient Rwanda. It served to teach bravery and promote physical strength. Young men competed in various ceremonies to demonstrate their skill and ability to win.

knowledge.title_rw: Ubugeni bwo gucura icyuma mu Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Ubugeni bwo gucura icyuma mu Rwanda bwari urwego rukomeye rw'ubukungu n'umuco mu mateka. Abanyabwenge b'abacuzi bakoreshaga amatako n'ibumba ngo bashONGESHE amabuye y'icyuma. Babikoreshaga bakora intwaro, ibikoresho by'ubuhinzi, n'imitako y'agaciro.
knowledge.summary_en: Traditional ironworking was an important economic and cultural practice in Rwandan history. Expert smiths used traditional furnaces and clay blowers to smelt iron ore. They manufactured weapons, agricultural tools, and valuable ornaments.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mbere, Abanyarwanda bambaraga impu z'inka cyangwa izindi nyamaswa. Impu zaroroshcywaga zikagirwa ubwiza bw'imyenda. Hanyuma, hagaje ibikorwa by'ubudozi bw'ibitenge n'imyenda yindi y'umuco.
knowledge.summary_en: Historically, Rwandans wore clothing made from cow hides or other animal skins. These hides were softened and prepared for daily wear. Later, traditional textile weaving and modern cultural fabrics became more common.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ibice bigize isi bigenda ku buryo buhoraho hejuru y'ubutaka bwo munsi bushyushye. Uku kugenda guterwa n'ubushyuhe bwo mu nda y'isi. Bituma habaho umutingito n'ibirunga. Bishobora no kurema imisozi miremire.
knowledge.summary_en: Plate tectonics is the scientific theory that Earth's outer shell is divided into several large plates that move over the mantle. This movement is driven by heat from Earth's interior and causes earthquakes, volcanic activity, and the formation of mountain ranges.

knowledge.title_rw: Kwita ku mubyeyi n'umwana nyuma y'uko abyaye
knowledge.summary_rw: Kwita ku mubyeyi n'umwana nyuma y'uko abyaye ni ingenzi cyane. Ibi bikubiyemo gusuzuma ubuzima bw'umubyeyi n'umwana kugira ngo hamenyekane niba nta ndwara cyangwa ibibazo bafite. Bitangira ako kanya umwana avutse kugeza ku minsi mirongo ine n'ine. Bisabwa ko umubyeyi ajya kwa muganga kugira ngo afashwe ndetse anahabwe inama ku mirire n'isuku.
knowledge.summary_en: Postnatal care is essential for the health of both mother and newborn. It usually involves medical checkups to monitor recovery and prevent complications. This care begins immediately after birth and continues for about six weeks. Mothers are encouraged to visit health facilities for clinical assessments, guidance on nutrition, and proper hygiene practices.

knowledge.title_rw: Gukurikirana no kuvura umuriro mu bana
knowledge.summary_rw: Umuriro mu bana usanzwe uterwa n'indwara ziterwa na mikorobe. Kugira ngo umwana afashwe, ni byiza kumwongerera amazi, kumwambika imyenda yoroheje, no gukoresha imiti nka paracetamol iyo bibaye ngombwa. Niba umwana afite imyaka iri munsi y'amezi atatu cyangwa afite ibimenyetso bikomeye, agomba kujyanwa kwa muganga vuba.
knowledge.summary_en: Fever in children is usually caused by common infections. To help a child, it is good to provide plenty of fluids, dress them in light clothing, and sometimes use medications like paracetamol if necessary. If an infant is under three months old or shows severe symptoms, medical attention should be sought promptly.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gukaraba buri munsi bifasha gukuraho imyanda n'amavuta menshi ku ruhu. Guha uruhu amazi ahagije no kurinda izuba bifasha mu buzima bwiza bw'uruhu. Kwitwararika kuisuku birinda indwara zitandukanye.
knowledge.summary_en: Daily washing helps remove dirt and excess oil from the skin. Keeping the skin hydrated and protected from the sun promotes good skin health. Proper hygiene helps prevent various skin conditions.

knowledge.summary_rw: Abiru bari abanyamateka b'ibanga mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Bashinzwe kubika no gutangaza amateka y'ubwami n'amategekoashingiye ku migenzo. Ibyo bimenyetso byatangwaga mu ibanga rikomeye ku mwami mushya.
knowledge.summary_en: Abiru were traditional oral historians and secret keepers in the historical Kingdom of Rwanda. They were responsible for preserving and transmitting royal history, rituals, and customary laws, which were passed down in strict confidence.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imboni y'ubwami yari igice cy'ingenzi cy'ibimenyetso by'ubwami mu Rwanda rwo hambere. Ibi bimenyetso byagaragazaga ububasha n'ubusugire bw'umwami n'igihugu. Byarimo ibintu bitandukanye bifite agaciro gakomeye k'amateka n'umuco.
knowledge.summary_en: Imboni y'ubwami was an essential part of the royal regalia in ancient Rwanda. These symbols represented the power and sovereignty of the king and the nation. They included various objects of great historical and cultural value.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwami bwa Buganda ni bumwe mu bwami bwa kera bwari mu karere k'ibiyaga bigari bya Afurika. Bwashinzwe mu kinyejana cya 14. Bwaje kuba ubwami bukomeye mu karere ka Uganda y'ubu. Umwami wabyo yitwa Kabaka. Abaganda bafite umuco n'amateka akomeye.
knowledge.summary_en: The Kingdom of Buganda is one of the ancient kingdoms in the African Great Lakes region. It was founded around the 14th century. It grew into a powerful state in present-day Uganda. Its traditional ruler is known as the Kabaka. The Baganda people have a rich culture and history.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gucunga amafaranga yinjira n'asohoka bifasha ubucuruzi kumenya neza umutungo bukenye. Bisaba gukurikiranira hafi amafaranga yose yinjiye n'ayasohotse kugira ngo ubucuruzi bukomeze gukora neza. Ibi bituma ubucuruzi bwirinda ibibazo by'amikoro make.
knowledge.summary_en: Managing cash flow helps a business understand its financial liquidity. It usually involves tracking all money entering and leaving the business to ensure smooth daily operations. This practice helps businesses avoid sudden financial shortages.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imitungo y'ubucuruzi ni ibintu bifite agaciro umucuruzi afite bifasha mu bikorwa bye. Imyenda ni amafaranga cyangwa ibintu ubucuruzi bwenda abandi bantu. Gusobanukirwa ibi bifasha kumenya uko ubucuruzi buhagaze.
knowledge.summary_en: Business assets are valuable resources owned that help generate revenue. Liabilities are financial obligations or debts owed to outside parties. Understanding both helps determine the financial health of a business.

knowledge.title_rw: Ibanze ku bitumizwa mu mahanga n'iboherezwayo mu Rwanda
knowledge.title_en: Import and export basics in Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Gutumiza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga no kuboherezayo bifasha u Rwanda mu bucuruzi. Ibikenerwa cyane ni ibikomoka kuri peteroli n'ibiribwa. Ibyoherezwa hanze ni ikawa, icyayi n'amabuye y'agaciro. Ibigo nka Rwanda Revenue Authority na Rwanda Development Board bifasha muri ibi bikorwa.
knowledge.summary_en: Importing and exporting are key to Rwanda trade. Common imports usually include petroleum products and foodstuffs. Main exports are coffee, tea, and minerals. Institutions like Rwanda Revenue Authority and Rwanda Development Board facilitate these business activities.

knowledge.title_rw: Uruhare rw'amakoperative mu bucuruzi bw'u Rwanda
knowledge.title_en: The role of cooperatives in Rwandan commerce
knowledge.summary_rw: Amakoperative afasha abaturage kwiteza imbere binyuze mu kongera umusaruro no guhuza imbaraga mu bucuruzi. Atanga amahirwe yo kubona inguzanyo no guteza imbere ubukungu bw'igihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: Cooperatives help citizens improve their livelihoods by increasing production and pooling resources for business. They provide access to credit opportunities and promote national economic development.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umurongo Mpuzamahanga w'Itariki ni umurongo wo mu nyanja ya Pacific uhindura itariki. Iyo wambutse uva iburasirazuba ujya iburengerazuba, wongeraho umunsi umwe. Iyo uva iburengerazuba ujya iburasirazuba, ukuraho umunsi umwe. Uyu umurongo unyura hafi ya meridian ya 180.
knowledge.summary_en: The International Date Line is an imaginary line in the Pacific Ocean that marks the boundary between calendar dates. Crossing it from east to west adds one day. Crossing from west to east subtracts one day. The line generally follows the 180 degree meridian.

knowledge.title_rw: Kwiga indimi no kuvuga indimi nyinshi
knowledge.summary_rw: Kwiga indimi nyinshi bifasha abantu gusobanukirwa imico itandukanye no kubona amahirwe y'akazi. Uburyo bwiza bwo kwiga ururimi rushya burimo kwiga buri munsi, kuvugana n'abandi, no gukoresha ibitabo cyangwa ikoranabuhanga. Kuvuga indimi nyinshi birinda ubwonko gusaza vuba bikongera n'ubushobozi bwo gutekereza.
knowledge.summary_en: Learning multiple languages helps people understand different cultures and increases career opportunities. Good strategies for learning a new language include daily practice, conversing with others, and using books or technology. Multilingualism can improve brain health and cognitive abilities over time.

knowledge.title_rw: Uburezi bwihariye n'ibyumba by'amashuri byakira bose
knowledge.title_en: Special needs education and inclusive classrooms
knowledge.summary_rw: Uburezi bwihariye bufasha abanyeshuri bafite ubumuga cyangwa ibindi bibazo byo kwiga. Ibyumba by'amashuri byakira bose bihuza abana bose hamwe kugira ngo bigirane. Ibi bituma buri munshuri abona ubufasha bukenewe kugira ngo atsinde mu ishuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Special needs education supports students with disabilities or other learning challenges. Inclusive classrooms bring all children together to learn side by side. This approach ensures every student receives the necessary support to succeed in school.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umubano mwiza hagati y'umwarimu n'umunyeshuri ufasha mu kwiga neza. Abarimu batanga inama no gushyigikira abanyeshuri kugira ngo bagere ku ntego zabo z'uburezi. Ibi bituma abanyeshuri bagira icyizere kandi bakitabira amasomo yabo neza.
knowledge.summary_en: A positive relationship between a teacher and a student promotes effective learning. Teachers usually provide guidance and support to help students achieve their educational goals. This helps students build confidence and engage better in their studies.

knowledge.summary_rw: Amateka n'uburezi bw'ubwenegihugu bifasha abaturage gusobanukira igihugu cyabo. Bisobanura indangagaciro z'umuco n'amateka y'u Rwanda. Ibi bifasha abaturage guharanira ubumwe n'amahoro. Byigishwa mu mashuri kugira ngo urubyiruko rukure rufite ubumenyi bukenewe mu kubaka igihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: History and civic education help citizens understand their country. They explain cultural values and the history of Rwanda. This helps citizens strive for unity and peace. They are taught in schools so youth grow up with the knowledge needed to build the nation.

knowledge.summary_rw: Volleyball ni umukino ukinwa n'amakipe abiri y'abakinnyi batandatu kuri buri ruhande. Intego y'umukino ni ugushyira umupira hasi mu kibuga cy'ikipe ihanganye. Amakipe yemerewe gukoraho umupira inshuro eshatu gusa mbere yo kuwugarura mu kibuga cy'abandi.
knowledge.summary_en: Volleyball is a sport played by two teams of six players each. The objective is to ground the ball on the opponent's court. Teams are typically allowed up to three touches before returning the ball over the net.

knowledge.title_rw: Amategeko y'ibanze na gahunda y'amakandara muri Karate
knowledge.summary_rw: Karate ni umukino w'ubwirinzi ukomoka mu Buyapani ushimika ku bumenyi bwo kwirwanaho, ikinyabupfura n'umuco mwiza. Abawukina bambara amakandara atandukanye atangirira ku mweru agera ku mukara, asobanura urwego rw'ubumenyi n'umuhati mu myitozo.
knowledge.summary_en: Karate is a martial art originating from Japan that emphasizes mental discipline, self-defense, and moral character. Practitioners advance through a belt system, typically starting with white and progressing to black, which signifies skill level, dedication, and knowledge.

knowledge.summary_rw: Cricket ni umukino w'amakipe abiri akinishwa agati kitwa bat n'umupira. Abakinnyi bambara ingofero n'uburinzi bw'ibirenge kugira ngo birinde imvune. Umukinnyi ukubita umupira agerageza kuwujya kure kugira ngo atahure amanota menshi ashoboka.
knowledge.summary_en: Cricket is a team sport played with a bat and a ball. Players wear helmets and pads to prevent injuries. The batter tries to hit the ball far to score as many runs as possible.

knowledge.summary_rw: Netball ni umukino w'amakipe abiri aho buri kipe igira abakinnyi barindwi mu kibuga. Icyiciro cy'ingenzi ni uko abakinnyi bagomba gukinira mu byanya byagenewe buri muntu hakurikije umwanya we. Ntibyemewe kwiruka witwaje umupira cyangwa kugenda na wo. Umukino uba ugamije gutsinda ibitego byinshi unyuze mu nseke idafite ikirahuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Netball is a team sport where each team has seven players on the court. A key rule is that players must stay in designated areas according to their specific position. Running with the ball or walking while holding it is not allowed. The main objective is to score goals by throwing the ball through a ring without a backboard.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gutwika inkwi cyangwa gukoresha amashanyarazi nabi bishobora guteza inkongi mu rugo. Kugira ngo wirinde, ugomba gusuzuma insinga z'amashanyarazi buri gihe. Ntugasige amashyiga yaka cyangwa amatara y'amashanyarazi arimo gukora udahari. Bika ibintu bifata inkongi kure y'umuriro.
knowledge.summary_en: Using firewood or electricity improperly can cause home fires. To prevent fires, inspect electrical wiring regularly. Never leave burning stoves or electrical appliances unattended. Store flammable materials safely away from heat sources.

knowledge.summary_rw: Amashanyarazi ashobora guteza akaga gakomeye nko gushya cyangwa urupfu naramuka akoreshejweabi. Ugomba kwirinda gukora ku bikoresho by'amashanyarazi n'amaboko atose. Ntukishyireho insinga zangiritse kandi ugomba kwitabaza inzobere mu bikorwa byose by'amashanyarazi mu nzu yawe.
knowledge.summary_en: Electricity can cause severe hazards such as burns or death if handled improperly. You should avoid touching electrical appliances with wet hands. Never use damaged wires and always consult a qualified professional for any electrical work in your home.

knowledge.title_rw: Isuku y'ibiribwa n'uburyo bwo kwirinda uburozi bwabyo
knowledge.title_en: Basic food hygiene and preventing food poisoning
knowledge.summary_rw: Isuku y'ibiribwa niingenzi mu kwirinda uburwayi buterwa n'ibiribwa bihumanye. Tugomba gukaraba intoki mbere yo guteka cyangwa kurya. Imbuto n'imboga bigomba gukarabwa n'amazi meza. Ibiribwa bikizebigomba gutekwa neza. Gutandukanya ibiribwa bikiri bisi n'ibitetse bifasha kwirinda mikorobe. Kubika ibiribwa mu bipimo by'ubushyuhe bukwiriye birinda ko byangirika.
knowledge.summary_en: Food hygiene is essential to prevent illnesses caused by contaminated food. We should wash our hands before cooking or eating. Fruits and vegetables must be washed with clean water. Food should be cooked thoroughly. Separating raw and cooked foods helps prevent germs. Storing food at appropriate temperatures prevents it from spoiling.

knowledge.summary_rw: Kurinda amakuru bwite kuri interineti bisaba kwitonda mu byo usangiza abandi. Ugomba gukoresha amagambo y'ibanga akomeye kandi ntiwishingikirize ku mbuga zitizewe. Kugenzura ibyerekeye umutekano w'imbuga ukoresha bifasha mu kwirinda uburiganya.
knowledge.summary_en: Protecting personal data on the internet requires careful sharing of information. You should use strong passwords and avoid untrusted websites. Checking privacy settings helps prevent online fraud.

knowledge.summary_rw: Igereranya rigereranya umubare w'ibintu bibiri cyangwa byinshi bifite ubwoko bumwe. Uburinganire bwerekana ko ibigereranyo bibiri bingana. Ibi bikoreshwa cyane mu gukemura ibibazo by'imibare byerekeye uburinganire bw'ibintu.
knowledge.summary_en: A ratio compares two or more quantities of the same kind. A proportion states that two ratios are equal. These concepts are commonly used to solve mathematical problems involving proportional relationships.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umubyimba ni umubare w'umwanya ikintu cy'icyerekezo cya gatatu gifata. Ubuso ni ubuso bwose bugaragara bw'ikintu. Aya makuru afasha mu kubara ibikoresho no mu mibare.
knowledge.summary_en: Volume is the amount of three-dimensional space an object occupies. Surface area is the total area of all the surfaces of an object. These concepts are used in measurement and geometry.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imibare iri munsi ya zero ni imibare ifite agaciro gato kuri zero. Ikoreshwa mu kwerekana ibintu nko gukonja cyangwa imyenda. Iyo wongewe kuri zero cyangwa indi mibare, bigabanya agaciro kayo.
knowledge.summary_en: Negative numbers are values less than zero. They are typically used to represent concepts such as below-zero temperatures or financial debt. When combined with positive numbers, they reduce the overall value.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubushobozi bw'ibintu bugaragaza amahiriryo y'uko ikintu cyaba cyangwa cyabaho. Igipimo cyabyo kiri hagati ya zero na rimwe. Zero ivuga ko ikintu kidashobora kubaho na rimwe. Rimwe bivuga ko kizaba nta gushidikanya. Ibi byifashishwa mu mibare no mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
knowledge.summary_en: Probability measures the likelihood that an event will occur. Values typically range from zero to one. Zero means an event is impossible, while one means it is certain. This concept is widely used in mathematics and daily life.

knowledge.summary_rw: Intore ni imbyino gakondo yo mu Rwanda. Yahoze ari iy'abami n'ingabo zabo. Ababyinnyi bambara imyerero n'ingabo ku mutwe. Баbyina bagaragaza ubutwari n'amahoro.
knowledge.summary_en: Intore is a traditional dance form from Rwanda. It was historically performed for the royal court and warriors. Dancers wear mane-like hairpieces and carry spears. The performance showcases bravery, grace, and peace.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwiyongere bw'igiciro cy'ibintu ni igihe agaciro k'amafaranga kagabanuka mu gihe ibiciro by'ibyenerwa byose byiyongera. Ibi bituma abantu bagura bike ugereranyije na mbere. Banki Nkuru y'Igihugu igenzura ubwo bwiyongere kugira ngo ubukungu bukomeze kuba bwiza.
knowledge.summary_en: Inflation is the general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money over time. This means people can buy less with the same amount of money. Central banks usually monitor and manage inflation to keep the economy stable.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gushyiraho ntego z'imari bifasha umuntu gutegura ejo heza. Bigabanyije mu ntego z'igihe gito n'igihe kirekire. Gutegura neza bifasha kwirinda imyenda no kugera ku bwisanzure bw'amafaranga. Burijwe umuntu akwiriye kugira gahunda ihamye yo kuzigama no gukoresha neza umutungo we.
knowledge.summary_en: Financial goal setting helps individuals plan for their future. Goals are typically divided into short-term and long-term categories. Proper planning helps avoid debt and achieves financial independence. Everyone should have a consistent plan for saving and managing their resources effectively.

knowledge.summary_rw: Kugira inkomoko zitandukanye z'amafaranga y'injiza bisobanura ko umuntu afite amasoko menshi y'amafaranga. Bishobora kurinda umuntu ingorane z'imari igihe kimwe cy'ubucuruzi cyangwa akazi gihuye n'ibibazo. Bifasha abantu kongera umutungo wabo no kugera ku ntego zabo z'imari byihuse.
knowledge.summary_en: Multiple streams of income means having more than one source of revenue. This financial strategy can help protect individuals if one business or job faces difficulties. It usually helps people grow their wealth and achieve their financial goals faster.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inyandiko z'imari zerekana uko ubucuruzi buhagaze mu buryo bw'amafaranga. Zirimo urupapuro rw'ibyo umutungo n'imyenda bingana, n'urupapuro rw'inyungu n'igihombo. Ibi bifasha abayobozi n'abashoramari gufata ibyemezo byiza.
knowledge.summary_en: Financial statements show the financial position of a business. They typically include the balance sheet and the income statement. These documents help managers and investors make informed decisions.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubwami bwa Kongo bwari ubwami bukomeye muri Afurika yo hagati. Bwategekaga ubutaka burimo ibihugu bitatu by'ubu ari byo Angola, Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi ya Kongo, na Repubulika ya Kongo. Bwatangiye mu kinyejana cya cumi na gatatu maze butera imbere mu bucuruzi n'ubutegetsi.
knowledge.summary_en: The Kingdom of Kongo was a powerful state in central Africa. Its territory included parts of modern-day Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the Republic of the Congo. It was founded around the thirteenth century and grew through trade and political centralization.

knowledge.summary_rw: Intambara za Punike zari eshatu zahuje Roma na Carthage hagati ya 264 na 146 mbere ya Yezu. Izi ntambara zatsinzwe na Roma. Zatumye Roma iba ubutegetsi bukomeye mu Nyanja ya Mediterane.
knowledge.summary_en: The Punic Wars were a series of three conflicts fought between Rome and Carthage from 264 to 146 BC. Rome emerged victorious in these wars. This outcome established Roman dominance over the Mediterranean region.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubutayu bwa Sahara ni ubutayu bunini cyane ku isi bufite ubutaka bwumye. Buherereye mu majyaruguru ya Afurika. Bugira ubushyuhe bwinshi ku zuba n'imbeho cyane nijoro.
knowledge.summary_en: The Sahara Desert is the largest hot desert in the world, located in northern Africa. It is characterized by extremely arid conditions, high daytime temperatures, and significant temperature drops at night.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inyanja ya Mediterane iherereye hagati y'Uburayi, Afurika na Aziya. Ifite ubuso bwa kilometero kare miliyoni ebyiri n'igice. Ihuriye n'Inyanja ya Atlantika binyuze mu gace ka Gibraltar. Igira uruhare rukomeye mu bucuruzi n'amateka y'ibihugu biyikikije.
knowledge.summary_en: The Mediterranean Sea is located between Europe, Africa, and Asia. It covers an area of about 2.5 million square kilometers. It connects to the Atlantic Ocean through the Strait of Gibraltar. It plays a major role in the trade and history of surrounding countries.

knowledge.summary_rw: Uburengero bw'ibidukikije mu mashuri bufasha abanyeshuri gusobanukirwa akamaro ko kubungabunga ibidukikije. Bigisha uburyo bwo gukoresha neza umutungo kamere no kurwanya ihindagurika ry'ikirere. Abanyeshuri bigishwa gukora ibikorwa nko gutera ibiti no gukuraho imyanda mu buryo burambye.
knowledge.summary_en: Environmental education in schools helps students understand the importance of protecting the environment. It teaches ways to use natural resources wisely and combat climate change. Students usually learn to participate in activities like tree planting and sustainable waste management.

knowledge.summary_rw: Uruhare rw'ababyeyi mu burezi rufasha abana kwitwara neza ku ishuri no gutsinda. Ababyeyi bagomba kuganira n'abana ku byo biga no kubabonera ibikoresho. Ubufatanye hagati y'ishuri n'umuryango butuma umwana agira imyitwarire myiza.
knowledge.summary_en: Parental involvement in education usually helps children perform better in school and succeed. Parents should discuss schoolwork with their children and provide necessary supplies. Collaboration between school and family promotes positive behavior in children.

knowledge.title_en: Creative Arts and Music Education in Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Uburezi bw'ubuhanzi n'umuziki bufasha abanyeshuri mu iterambere ry'ubwenge n'imyitwarire myiza. Muri gahunda y'uburezi mu Rwanda, amasomo y'ubuhanzi agamije guteza imbere ubumenyi bufatika, umuco nyarwanda, no guhanga udushya. Abanyeshuri bigishwa kuririmba, gucuranga, kubyina, no gushushanya kugira ngo bamenye kwigaragaza neza mu buzima bwabo bwa buri munsi n'isoko ry'umurimo.
knowledge.summary_en: Creative arts and music education help students develop cognitive skills and positive behavior. In Rwanda's education system, arts subjects aim to promote practical skills, Rwandan culture, and innovation. Students learn singing, playing instruments, dancing, and drawing to express themselves effectively in daily life and prepare for future careers.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inama n'ubuyobozi ku iterambere ry'umwuga bifasha abanyeshuri kumenya impano zabo n'amahirwe y'akazi ahari. Ibi bikorwa bituma bafata ibyemezo byiza ku masomo yabo y'ejo hazaza hagamijwe gutsinda mu kazi.
knowledge.summary_en: Career guidance and counseling help students discover their skills and explore available job opportunities. These services enable them to make informed educational and professional choices for future success.

knowledge.title_en: Early childhood development and preschool education
knowledge.summary_rw: Iterambere ry'abana b'incuke n'amashuri y'inshuke bifasha abana bato mu mitekerereze n'imibereho myiza. Amashuri y'inshuke ategura abana kujya mu mashuri abanza. Abana biga binyuze mu mikino n'ibikorwa bifatika.
knowledge.summary_en: Early childhood development and preschool education help young children grow mentally and socially. Preschools prepare children for primary school. Children usually learn through play and practical activities.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubumenyi bwo impaka no kuvuga imbere y'abantu bufasha abanyeshuri gutekereza neza no gutanga ibitekerezo byabo mu mucyo. Mu Rwanda, amashuri menshi ashyiraho amatsinda y'impaka kugira ngo ateze imbere ubushobozi bw'abanyeshuri mu gutanga ibimenyetso no kumvisha abandi.
knowledge.summary_en: Debate and public speaking skills help students think critically and express their ideas clearly. In many Rwandan schools, debate clubs are established to improve students' abilities in presenting arguments and persuading others effectively.

knowledge.title_rw: Uburyo bwo kujugunya muri Judo n'ibanze ku kurwana hasi
knowledge.summary_rw: Judo ni umukino w'imirwano ukomoka mu Buyapani. Ushingiye ku buryo bubiri bw'ingenzi: kujugunya uwo muhanganye hasi (Nage-waza) no kumugenzura hasi cyangwa kumuniga (Katame-waza). Abakinnyi bakoresha imbaraga z'uwo bahanganye kugira ngo bamutsinde.
knowledge.summary_en: Judo is a martial art originating from Japan. It focuses on two main techniques: throwing an opponent to the ground (Nage-waza) and controlling or choking them on the ground (Katame-waza). Athletes usually use their opponent's momentum to win.

knowledge.summary_rw: Hockey mu kibuga ni umukino ukinirwa n'amakipe abiri afite abakinnyi cumi na umwe buri kipe. Abakinnyi bakoresha inkoni y'uruhande rumwe gusa kugira ngo bakubite umupira. Ntibyemewe gukora ku mupira n'amaboko, keretse umunyezamu mu rubuga rwe. Intego ni ukwinjiza umupira mu izamu ry'ikipe ihanganye.
knowledge.summary_en: Field hockey is a sport played by two teams of eleven players each. Players use a stick that is flat on one side only to hit the ball. Touching the ball with hands is not allowed, except for the goalkeeper within their circle. The objective is to score goals by putting the ball into the opponent's net.

knowledge.title_rw: Uburyo bwo kwitwara muri Golf no guhitamo inkoni
knowledge.summary_rw: Golf ni umukino usaba imyitwarire myiza n'icyubahiro ku kibuga. Abakinnyi bagomba guceceka abandi batera umupira no kwitondera aho bahagarara. Guhitamo inkoni ikwiye bitewe n'interuro n'uburebure bwa terrain bifasha umukinnyi kugera ku ntego ye neza.
knowledge.summary_en: Golf is a sport that requires good etiquette and respect on the course. Players must remain quiet while others take their shot and pay attention to their positioning. Selecting the right club based on the distance and terrain helps a player achieve their goal successfully.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu gihe cy'umutingito w'isi, ugomba kwitwara neza ukamenya icyo ukora. Banza wunamye, wipfuke umutwe, kandi wifatanye n'ikintu gikomeye kugira ngo wirinde. Nyuma y'umutingito, genzura niba nta bikomere ufite kandi witondere ibindi bishobora gukurikiraho.
knowledge.summary_en: During an earthquake, proper safety actions are essential. Drop to the ground, cover your head and neck, and hold on to sturdy shelter to protect yourself. After shaking stops, check for injuries and remain cautious of potential aftershocks.

knowledge.title_rw: Umutekano ku igare no kwambara ingofero
knowledge.summary_rw: Kwitwara ku igare bisaba kwambara ingofero irinda kugira ngo wirinde gukomereka umutwe mu byago. Ugomba no kwitondera imihanda no kureba ko feri zikora neza.
knowledge.summary_en: Bicycle safety requires wearing a helmet to prevent head injuries in case of accidents. You should also pay attention to traffic and ensure your brakes work properly.

knowledge.title_rw: Kurwanira izuba no kwirinda ubushyuhe bukabije
knowledge.title_en: Sun safety and heat exhaustion prevention
knowledge.summary_rw: Gukingira umubiri izuba bifasha kwirinda gushya no kurwara. Unywa amazi menshi kugira ngo udashyuha cyane. Wambara imyenda miremire n'ingofero. Utinda mu gicucu izuba ryinshi rifite.
knowledge.summary_en: Protecting the body from the sun helps prevent sunburn and heat exhaustion. Drinking plenty of water helps avoid overheating. Wearing long clothes and hats provides defense. Staying in the shade during peak hours is helpful.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gukiza no kwirinda kuribwa n'imbwa bifasha mu gukumira indwara y'umucuru. Ingingo z'ingenzi zirimo gukingira imbwa no kwivuza vuba iyo urumwe. Umucuru ni indwara iterwa na virusi ishobora kwica abantu n'inyamaswa. Ntugakore ku mbwa zitazwi kandi wubahe inyamaswa.
knowledge.summary_en: Preventing dog bites helps control rabies. Key measures include vaccinating dogs and seeking prompt medical treatment after a bite. Rabies is a viral disease that can be fatal to humans and animals. Avoid unfamiliar dogs and respect animals.

knowledge.title_en: Family members and relatives in Kinyarwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda, hari amazina atandukanye yihariye yo kwita abagize umuryango n'abavandimwe. Ibi bisobanura isano y'amaraso cyangwa iy'abashakanye. Urugero, data ni papa, naho mama ni mama. Aya magambo agaragaza icyubahiro n'ubucuti mu muryango nyarwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: In Kinyarwanda, there are specific terms used to name family members and relatives. These terms usually define blood relations or marital ties. For example, data means father, and mama means mother. These words often show respect and closeness within the Rwandan family.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda, amazina y'ibiribwa n'ibinyobwa akoreshwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi afite inkomoko muco nyarwanda. Urugero, umutsima ukorwa mu ifarini, naho amata akaba ikinyobwa cy'ingenzi cy'aborozi. Ibi biribwa biha abantu imbaraga kandi bigira uruhare runini mu mibereho yabo.
knowledge.summary_en: In Kinyarwanda, the names of food and drink used daily have cultural roots in Rwanda. For example, umutsima is made from flour, and milk is an important drink for herders. These items provide energy and play a major role in people's lives.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inshinga z'Ikinyarwanda zigizwe n'umuzi n'ibyugo bigaragaza ibihe, abantu n'ubwoko bw'inteko. Izi nteko zihura n'izina rihamagarwa mu ntera zitandukanye. Uko inshinga yanditswe cyangwa yavuzwe ihinduka bitewe n'igihe cyangwa n'uburyo ikoreshejwemo.
knowledge.summary_en: Kinyarwanda verbs consist of a root and affixes that typically indicate tense, subject agreement, and noun classes. These agreement markers match the noun class of the subject. Verb forms change depending on the tense, aspect, or mood being expressed in the sentence.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guhuza ubuhinzi n'amashyamba bisobanura gutera ibiti hamwe n'imyaka cyangwa ubworozi kubutaka bumwe. Ubu buryo bufasha kongeraumusaruro w'ubutaka, kurinda ubutaka kwangirika, no gutanga inkwi n'ibiryo by'amatungo. Bifasha kandi mu kubungabunga ibidukikije no guhangana n'ihindagurika ry'ikirere mu Rwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: Agroforestry systems involve integrating trees with agricultural crops or livestock on the same land. This practice helps increase land productivity, prevents soil erosion, and provides firewood and animal fodder. It also supports environmental conservation and helps mitigate climate change effects in Rwanda.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ubworozi bw'ifi mu Rwanda buragenda butera imbere. Leta n'abikorera barateza imbere ubworozi bw'ifi mu biyaga n'amakibaya. Ibi bifasha mu kongera ibiribwa bikungahaye kuri poroteyine no guteza imbere ubukungu bw'abaturage.
knowledge.summary_en: Aquaculture in Rwanda is growing steadily. The government and private sector promote fish farming in lakes, ponds, and reservoirs. This practice helps increase the supply of protein-rich food and improves community livelihoods.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gutegura iby'umutungo ni uguteganya uko ibyo umuntu asigaranye bizacungwa cyangwa bizahabwa abazabirya nyuma y'urupfu rwe. Ibi bikubiyemo kwandika ibyemezo by'izungura, gushyiraho ababifitiye ububasha, no gufata ingamba zo kugabanya imisoro y'ubutegetsi.
knowledge.summary_en: Estate planning involves arranging how a person's assets will be managed and distributed after their death. This process usually includes writing a will, establishing powers of attorney, and taking steps to minimize probate taxes and legal complications.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guhinduranya amafaranga y'amahanga bivuze kugura cyangwa kugurisha amafaranga y'igihugukimwe uyajyana mu cyindi. Igiciro cyo guhinduranya gihinduka buri gihe bitewe n'isoko mpuzamahanga. Banki n'ibigo by'imari ni byo byemerewe gufasha abantu guhindura amafaranga.
knowledge.summary_en: Currency exchange means trading the money of one country for another. The exchange rate usually changes constantly based on the global market. Banks and financial institutions are typically authorized to help people exchange currencies.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imyumvire y'amafaranga yerekana uburyo ibitekerezo n'imico yacu bigenga uko dukoresha amafaranga. Ntabwo ari ubumenyi bw'imibare gusa, ahubwo ni ukumenya uko twitwara imbere y'amafaranga. Kugira ubukungu bushingiye ku kwitonda bisaba kwigengesera no kwiga kwihangana mu gufata ibyemezo.
knowledge.summary_en: The psychology of money explains how our thoughts and behaviors influence financial decisions. Managing wealth depends more on personal behavior than on technical math skills. Building financial stability usually requires patience, discipline, and emotional control when dealing with money.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gutanga imfashanyo ni igikorwa cyo gufasha abakeneye ubufasha hagamijwe kuzamura imibereho yabo. Mu Rwanda, ibi bikorwa binyura mu miryango itegamiye kuri Leta, amadini cyangwa ku giti cyumuntu. Bituma habaho iterambere ry'abaturage no kugabanya ubukene.
knowledge.summary_en: Philanthropy involves giving money, time, or resources to help those in need and improve social welfare. In Rwanda, charitable giving is often channeled through non-governmental organizations, religious institutions, or individual initiatives. It contributes to community development and poverty reduction.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imigabane igurishwa mu masoko y'imari n'imigabano itanga uburenganzira bwo kuba umunyamigabane muri sosiyete. Impapuro mpeshafite z'inguzanyo cyangwa se bond zo ni inguzanyo abashoramari baguriza leta cyangwa ibigo. Leta cyangwa ibigo byishyura inyungu ku gihe kandi bigasubiza amafaranga y'ibanze igihe icyo cy'inguzanyo kirangiye.
knowledge.summary_en: Stocks sold in financial markets represent ownership shares in a company. Bonds are fixed-income instruments where investors loan money to governments or corporations. The issuer pays periodic interest and returns the principal upon maturity, usually offering lower risk than stocks.

knowledge.title_rw: Umuco wo gukora ubuki mu Rwanda
knowledge.summary_rw: U Rwanda rufite amateka maremare mu bworozi bw'inzuki. Aborozi bakoreshaga amizinga y'ibiti. Bashyiraga amizinga mu biti birebire. Gutera akuka byabaga nijoro. Abaturage bakoreshaga umwotsi kugira ngo birukane inzuki. Ubuki bwagiraga akamaro mu mirire n'imiti.
knowledge.summary_en: Rwanda has a long history of beekeeping. Beekeepers traditionally used wooden hives. Hives were placed high in tall trees. Harvesting usually took place at night. People used smoke to calm the bees. Honey played an important role in nutrition and traditional medicine.

knowledge.summary_rw: Abanyarwanda bo hambere bamenyaga ibihe n'amasaha binyuze mu kwitegereza inyenyeri n'ukwezi. Uko ibihe by'umwaka byahinduragahinduraga byabafashaga kumenya igihe cyo guhinga no gusarura. Iri genamibare ryashingiraga ku miterere y'ikirere n'imibereho y'aborozi n'abahinzi.
knowledge.summary_en: Ancient Rwandans tracked seasons and time by observing stars and the moon. Seasonal changes helped them determine when to plant and harvest crops. This indigenous knowledge system was based on atmospheric patterns and the lifestyle of farmers and herders.

knowledge.title_rw: Imikino gakondo y'iteramakofi no kwirwanaho mu Rwanda
knowledge.title_en: Traditional Rwandan martial arts and self-defense
knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, habagaho uburyo bwo kwirwanaho no guhangana hakoreshejwe imbaraga z'umubiri n'ubuhanga. Imikino nk'iteramakofi n'amarushanwa yo gusunikana byafashaga abagabo n'abasore kugira ubuzima bwiza no kurinda umuryango wabo. Ibyo bikorwa byari bifite akamaro mu muco no mu mutekano w'igihugu.
knowledge.summary_en: In ancient Rwanda, there were traditional methods of self-defense and combat using physical strength and skill. Sports like traditional wrestling and boxing helped men and youth maintain fitness and protect their communities. These activities played an important role in culture and local security.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Rwanda rwo hambere, abaturage bakoraga umunyu mu byondo cyangwa mu bimera byihariye. Ibi byondo cyangwa imyinge byacanirwaga bikavamo umunyu w'imborera wakoreshwaga mu buzima bwa buri munsi no mu gihe cy'ubucuruzi bw'ubuterane.
knowledge.summary_en: In ancient Rwanda, people produced salt from specific marsh soils or plants. These materials were usually filtered and boiled to extract local salt used for daily consumption and early regional trade.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umuheha w'ubuhumekero bw'umuntu ugizwe n'imyanya y'ubuhumekero n'ibihaha. Utwara umwuka wa ogisijeni mu mubiri kandi ugakuramo umwuka wa karuboni diokiside. Amahaha ni yo akora ivunjurwa ry'imyuka mu maraso.
knowledge.summary_en: The human respiratory system consists of the respiratory tract and lungs. It supplies oxygen to the body and removes carbon dioxide. The lungs are responsible for gas exchange in the blood.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mitosis ni uburyo uturemangingo tw'umubiri twitandukanya kugira ngo haturemo utundi turemangingo tubiri dufite amakuru y'umurage asa neza. Ubu buryo bufasha mu gukura kw'umubiri no gukira kw'ibikomere.
knowledge.summary_en: Mitosis is a process of cell division that results in two daughter cells each having the same genetic material as the parent cell. This process is essential for body growth and tissue repair.

knowledge.summary_rw: Isuku y'amenyo ifasha kwirinda indwara z'amenyo n'ubumonyi. Gukaraba amenyo kabiri ku munsi na buruse na paste irimo fluoride bifasha gukuraho ibicuruzwa bisigara mu menyo. Kujya kwa muganga w'amenyo buri gihe bituma amenyo aguma meza.
knowledge.summary_en: Dental hygiene helps prevent tooth decay and gum diseases. Brushing teeth twice a day with a toothbrush and fluoride toothpaste helps remove food debris. Regular visits to a dentist help maintain good oral health.

knowledge.summary_rw: Indwara y'isi y'imitsi y'ubwonko iterwa n'uko amaraso adashobora kugera ku bwonko neza. Ibimenyetso bisanzwe birimo kugwa kw'akana ku ruhande rumwe, intege nke mu kuboko, n'imbogamizi mu kuvuga. Igihe ibi bimenyetso bigaragaye, hakenewe ubufasha bw'abaganga vuba.
knowledge.summary_en: A stroke occurs when blood flow to the brain is interrupted. Common signs usually include facial drooping, arm weakness, and speech difficulties. Immediate medical attention is required when these symptoms appear.

knowledge.summary_rw: Kwicara neza no guhagarara neza bifasha umugongo gukora neza. Bikabuza uburibazi bw'umugongo n'amagufa. Bisaba ko umugongo ugororoka kandi ibiro bikwira hose.
knowledge.summary_en: Good posture helps the spine function properly. It usually prevents back and joint pain. It requires keeping the spine aligned and distributing body weight evenly.

knowledge.title_rw: Aderesi za IP n'amazina y'imbuga za interineti
knowledge.summary_rw: Aderesi ya IP ni umubare uranga mudasomwa kuri interineti. Amazina y'imbuga za interineti afasha abantu kubona aho izo aderesi ziri mu buryo bworoshye. Sisitemu yitwa DNS ihindura ayo mazina aba aderesi za IP kugira ngo mudasomwa zishobore kuvugana.
knowledge.summary_en: An IP address is a numerical label that identifies devices on a network. Domain names make it easier for people to access these locations. The Domain Name System translates these human-readable names into IP addresses so computers can communicate.

knowledge.title_rw: Porogaramu nkingi zo kurinda urusobe rwa mudasobwa
knowledge.summary_rw: Porogaramu nkingi ni uburyo burinda urusobe rwa mudasobwa. Zigenzura amakuru yinjira n'asohoka. Zibuza abantu badafite uburenganzira kwinjira muri mudasobwa.
knowledge.summary_en: A firewall is a network security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing network traffic. It acts as a barrier between a trusted internal network and untrusted external networks like the internet.

knowledge.title_rw: Ubumenyi bwibanze ku miyoboro yihuza porogaramu
knowledge.summary_rw: API ni uburyo buhuza porogaramu ebyiri cyangwa zirenga kugira ngo zivugane. Ifasha porogaramu imwe gusaba amakuru cyangwa serivisi ku yindi. Zifashishwa cyangwa zikoreshwa cyane mu ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo serivisi zitandukanye zikorere hamwe byoroshye.
knowledge.summary_en: An API is a set of rules that allows different software applications to communicate with each other. It enables one program to request data or services from another system. APIs are widely used in technology to help various services work together smoothly.

knowledge.title_rw: Uburyo bwo gutunganya no kubika amakuru muri mudasobwa
knowledge.summary_rw: Uburyo bwo gutunganya no kubika amakuru bufasha mudasobwa gukora vuba. Array ni bumwe mu buryo bw'ibanze bwo kubika amakuru menshi afite ubwoko bumwe ku murongo umwe. Bituma ubushakashatsi bw'amakuru bworoha kandi bugakorwa vuba mu gihe cyo gukoresha porogaramu.
knowledge.summary_en: Data structures help computers organize and store information efficiently. An array is a fundamental data structure that usually stores a collection of elements of the same type in sequential memory locations. This allows programs to access and manipulate data quickly.

knowledge.summary_rw: Amasezerano y'ubucuruzi ni inyandiko yubahirizwa n'amategeko hagati y'impande ebyiri cyangwa more. Agaragaza ibyo buri ruwacu rwemeye gukora. Harimo ibijyanye no gutanga ibicuruzwa, kwishyura, n'igihe amasezerano azamara. Afasha abikorera kwirinda amakimbirane no kurengera uburenganzira bwabo mu gihe cy'ubucuruzi.
knowledge.summary_en: A commercial contract is a legally binding document between two or more parties. It outlines what each party agrees to do. It usually includes terms about goods, payment, and duration. These agreements help businesses prevent disputes and protect their legal rights during commercial activities.

knowledge.title_rw: Gucunga imyitozo yo mu rugo no kwiga wenyine
knowledge.summary_rw: Gucunga imyitozo yo mu rugo no kwiga wenyine bifasha abanyeshuri gutsinda neza. Biteganya igihe cyo kwiga, gushyira ibibanze imbere, no gushaka ahantu hatuje. Kwiga wenyine bituma umunyeshuri amenya kwifatira ibyemezo no kumva amasomo neza.
knowledge.summary_en: Homework management and independent study help students succeed academically. These practices involve scheduling study time, prioritizing tasks, and finding a quiet environment. Independent study develops self-discipline and deeper understanding of academic subjects.

knowledge.summary_rw: Isomero ni ahantu hafasha abanyeshuri n'abashakashatsi kubona ibitabo n'inyandiko zikenerwa. Gusura isomero bifasha kwiga neza no kubona amakuru yizewe. Abasomyi bashobora gushaka ibitabo bakoresheje amazina yabyo cyangwa ababanditsi.
knowledge.summary_en: A library is a place that helps students and researchers find necessary books and documents. Visiting a library helps in studying well and finding reliable information. Readers can usually search for books using their titles or authors.

knowledge.title_rw: Gufashanya mu kwiga no kugira abajyanama
knowledge.summary_rw: Gufashanya mu kwiga no kugira abajyanama bituma abanyeshuri bafashanya mu masomo no mu iterambere ryabo. Abanyeshuri bakuze cyangwa abafite ubumenyi bwinshi baha ubufasha abandi. Ibi bikoresha uburyo bwo gusangira ubumenyi. Byongera icyizere no gutsinda mu ishuri.
knowledge.summary_en: Peer tutoring and mentoring programs typically involve students helping each other with academics and personal growth. Older or more knowledgeable students usually support their peers. This approach fosters knowledge sharing and builds academic confidence.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umutekano kuri interineti ni ingenzi ku banyeshuri. Abanyeshuri bagomba kurinda amakuru yabo bwite. Ntibagomba gusangira amabanga yabo n'abantu batazi. Bagomba kandi kwitwara neza no kubaha abandi mu gihe bari ku mbuga nkoranyambaga.
knowledge.summary_en: Online safety is important for students. Students should protect their personal information. They should not share private details with strangers. They must also behave well and respect others while using social media.

knowledge.title_en: Health and nutrition for academic performance
knowledge.summary_rw: Kurya indyo yuzuye bifasha abanyeshuri kwiga neza. Ubwonko bukeneka intungamubiri kugira ngo bukore neza. Kunywa amazi ahagije bituma umunyeshuri atagira umunaniro mu ishuri. Amagara mazima atuma abana batiga basiba.
knowledge.summary_en: Eating a balanced diet generally helps students learn better. The brain typically needs proper nutrients to function well. Drinking enough water often prevents fatigue in class. Good health usually reduces student absenteeism.

knowledge.summary_rw: Raporo z'ishuri zerekana uko umunyeshuri yatsinze mu masomo n'imyitwarire ye. Ababyeyi basoma izi raporo kugira ngo bamenye aho umwana akomeye n'aho akeneye ubufasha. Ibi bifasha ababyeyi n'abarimu gukorana kugira ngo umwana atere imbere mu myigire ye.
knowledge.summary_en: School reports show a student's academic performance and behavior. Parents read these reports to understand where a child is strong and where they need help. This helps parents and teachers work together to support the child's learning progress.

knowledge.title_rw: Ibanze ya Ragby n'uburyo bwo gutsinda
knowledge.summary_rw: Ragby ni umukino w'amakipe abiri akinishwa umupira w'umuringoti. Intego ni ugutsinda amanota menshi kuruta andi. Gutsinda bitera ku buryo butandukanye nko gushyira umupira hasi mu rubuga rw'abakeba cyangwa gutera umupira hagati y'inkingi z'izamu.
knowledge.summary_en: Rugby is a team sport played with an oval ball. The objective is to score more points than the opponent. Points are typically scored by touching the ball down in the opponent's try zone or kicking it through the goalposts.

knowledge.summary_rw: Taekwondo ni umukino w'irwanishwa ukomoka muri Korea. Ukoresha cyane imigeri itandukanye n'imibare y'imyitozo yitwa poomsae. Uyu mukino ufasha mu kwirwanaho no mu buzima bwiza.
knowledge.summary_en: Taekwondo is a martial art originating from Korea. It heavily utilizes various kicking techniques and formalized practice patterns called poomsae. The sport aids in self-defense and physical fitness.

knowledge.summary_rw: Imyitozo ngororamubiri ishingiye ku bushobozi bwo kugenzura umubiri, imbaraga, no kuba umubiri woroheje. Abakinnyi bakora imyitozo yo kurambura kugira ngo boroheze ingingo zabo kandi birinde imvune. Iyi myitozo ifasha mu kuzamura uburinganire bw'umubiri n'ubushobozi bwo gukora ibikorwa bisaba ingufu nyinshi mu mikino itandukanye.
knowledge.summary_en: Gymnastics fundamentals focus on body control, strength, and flexibility. Athletes perform stretching exercises to keep their joints flexible and prevent injuries. These practices help improve overall physical balance and the ability to perform high-energy movements across various sports.

knowledge.summary_rw: Guterura ibiremereye bisaba uburyo bwiza n'umutekano kugira ngo wirinde imvune. Ugomba guhagarara neza, ugakoresha imitsi yo mu nda, kandi ukirinda kunama umugongo igihe uterura. Gutegura umubiri mbere bifasha imitsi ikomerera neza.
knowledge.summary_en: Weightlifting requires proper techniques and safety to prevent injuries. You should maintain a stable stance, engage your core muscles, and avoid rounding your back while lifting. Warming up before exercising helps your muscles prepare safely.

knowledge.title_rw: Ibikoresho by'umuheto n'uburyo bwo gufata intego
knowledge.summary_rw: Umuheto n'imyambi ni byo bikoresho fatizo mu mukino wo kurasa n'umuheto. Umukinnyi akoresha imigozi, ibimenyetso bifasha gufata intego, n'imyambaro yabugenewe. Kugira ngo umukinnyi atsinde, agomba guhagarara neza, akabanza kwerekana intego neza, akoresha ijisho rimwe mu kureba, hanyuma akarekura umugozi w'umuheto buhoro buhoro.
knowledge.summary_en: A bow and arrows are the primary equipment in archery. Anarcher typically uses a string, a sight to help with aiming, and protective gear. To succeed, an archer must maintain a proper stance, align with the target, use dominant eye sighting, and release the bowstring smoothly.

knowledge.summary_rw: Igihe imiyaga n'inkuba bihari, shaka aho wihisha mu nzu ifite amashanyarazi n'amazi meza. Irinde guhagarara munsi y'ibiti birebire cyangwa mu mirima ifunguye. Koresha ibikoresho bikingira inkuba mu nzu.
knowledge.summary_en: During thunderstorms, seek shelter inside a fully enclosed building with plumbing and electrical wiring. Avoid standing under tall trees or in open fields. Use lightning protection systems in buildings.

knowledge.title_rw: Ubumenyi bw'ibanze bwo koga no gutabara mu mazi
knowledge.title_en: Basic swimming and water rescue awareness
knowledge.summary_rw: Kwiga koga no kumenya ubwirinzi bw'ibanze mu mazi bifasha kwirinda kurohama. Ntukajye mu mazi wenyine kandi wirinde kujya ahanini utazi uburebure bwaho. Mu gihe umuntu arohamye, utabara ntagomba kujya mu mazi niba bishobora gushyira ubuzima bwe mu kaga; ahubwo akoresha inkoni cyangwa ikintu kirekire kugira ngo amufashe.
knowledge.summary_en: Learning to swim and knowing basic water safety helps prevent drowning. You should usually avoid swimming alone and stay away from deep water with unknown depths. During a rescue, a rescuer should generally avoid entering the water if it puts their own life at risk, and instead use a pole or a long object to help.

knowledge.summary_rw: Gusuzuma ibikoresho by'imikino buri gihe bifasha mu kwirindaimpanuka. Ibikoresho bigomba kuba bifite ishingiro rikomeye kandi bitangiritse. Gutera umusenyi cyangwa ibikoresho byoroshye munsi y'ibikoresho byo gukina bigabanya ingaruka zo kugwa.
knowledge.summary_en: Regular inspection of sports and playground equipment helps prevent accidents. Equipment must be structurally sound and free from damage. Installing soft surfaces like wood mulch or rubber mats underneath play structures reduces the severity of falls.

knowledge.title_rw: Kurwanya iterabwoba rya bagenzi no gushyiraho imbibi
knowledge.title_en: Peer pressure and personal boundary setting
knowledge.summary_rw: Gushyiraho imbibi bifasha abantu kwanga ibikorwa bibi bikomoka kuri bagenzi babo. Buri muntu afite uburenganzira bwo kuvuga oya ku bintu bitamunyuze. Ibi birinda umutekano we n'icyubahiro cye.
knowledge.summary_en: Setting personal boundaries helps individuals resist negative peer pressure. Everyone has the right to say no to things they are uncomfortable with. This protects their safety and personal dignity.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ikinyarwanda gifite uburyo bwo kubara bushingiye ku mubare icumi. Imibare kuva kuri rimwe kugera kuri icyenda igira utugereka twihariye. Mu kubara, amazina y'imibare akurikiza amateka y'ururimi n'imiterere y'amazina.
knowledge.summary_en: Kinyarwanda uses a decimal-based counting system. Numbers from one to nine have specific roots. When counting, the names of the numbers follow the grammatical rules and noun classes of the language.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda, ijambo umwenda risobanura icyambarwa cyose cyo kwambara ku mubiri. Imitako ni ibintu byose bikoreshwa mu kwiyandabika cyangwa se mu gushaka ubwiza. Hari amagambo menshi yihariye agaragaza amoko atandukanye y'imyenda n'imitako mu muco w'u Rwanda.
knowledge.summary_en: In Kinyarwanda, the word umwenda refers to any clothing worn on the body. Accessories are items used for adornment or to enhance beauty. There are many specific words that describe different types of clothing and accessories in Rwandan culture.

knowledge.summary_rw: Inzu ni aho abantu baba. Mu nzu habamo ibikoresho bitandukanye bifasha mu buzima bwa buri munsi. Bimwe muri ibyo bikoresho ni intebe zicarwaho, ameza akoreshwa mu kurya cyangwa kwandika, uburiri bwagenewe kuryamamo, n'ibindi byose bifasha mu isuku no guteka mu rugo.
knowledge.summary_en: A house is a place where people live. Inside a house, there are various items that help with daily life. Some of these items include chairs for sitting, tables used for eating or writing, beds meant for sleeping, and everything else that helps with cleanliness and cooking at home.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda, amazina y'imirimo n'imyuga akomoka ku nshinga cyangwa ku mazina y'ibintu. Umunyamakuru, umwarimu, n'umuganga ni ingero z'imirimo izwi. Izina ry'umuntu ukora umurimo uwo ari wo wose ritangira n'umugereka w'abantu nka umu- cyangwa aba-.
knowledge.summary_en: In Kinyarwanda, names of professions and occupations usually derive from verbs or nouns. Journalist, teacher, and doctor are examples of known professions. The name of a person performing any occupation typically starts with a noun class prefix such as umu- or aba-.

knowledge.summary_rw: Mu Kinyarwanda, icyerekezo n'aho ibintu biherereye bikoresha amagambo yihariye y'aho umuntu ahagaze cyangwa aho ikintu kiri. Amagambo nka ruguru, hepfo, imbere, n'inyuma akoreshwa kugira ngo agaragaze aho ikintu kiri ugereranyije n'ikindi.
knowledge.summary_en: In Kinyarwanda, directions and spatial locations use specific terms relative to a speaker or object's position. Words like ruguru (up/north), hepfo (down/south), imbere (front), and inyuma (behind) are commonly used to indicate relative locations.

knowledge.summary_rw: Ibarurishamibare ni ishami ry'imibare ryita ku gukusanya, gusesengura, no gutanga ubusobanuro ku makuru y'imibare. Rifasha abantu gufata ibyemezo bushingiye ku bimenyetso bifatika mu buzima bwa buri munsi no mu bushakashatsi.
knowledge.summary_en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics concerned with collecting, analyzing, and interpreting numerical data. It helps people make evidence-based decisions in daily life and research.

knowledge.summary_rw: Rubuga rw'imiburano ruzwi nka Cartesian plane rugizwe n'imitambiko ibiri yitwa x-axis na y-axis. Iyi mitambiko ihurira ku ngingo yitwa zero cyangwa origin. Iyi ngano ifasha mu gutanga imibare ibiri yerekana aho ikintu kiri.
knowledge.summary_en: A coordinate plane, also known as a Cartesian plane, consists of two perpendicular number lines called the x-axis and y-axis. These axes intersect at a point called the origin. This system allows every point to be located using an ordered pair of numbers.

knowledge.summary_rw: Umurongo utarangira ni umurongo ugororotse utagira iherezo. Inguni igizwe n'imirasire ibiri ihurira ku ngingo imwe yitwa ihuriro. Inguni zigereranywa mu mperi cyangwa dogere. Iyo imirongo ibiri ihura igakora inguni ya dogere mirongo icyenda, iba ihagaritse.
knowledge.summary_en: A line is a straight path that extends infinitely in both directions. An angle is formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint called a vertex. Angles are usually measured in degrees. When two lines intersect at a ninety-degree angle, they are perpendicular.
